meta.name: cro
meta.description: When the user wants to optimize, improve, or increase conversions on any marketing page or form — including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, lead capture forms, or contact forms. Also use when the user says 'CRO,' 'conversion rate optimization,' 'this page isn't converting,' 'improve conversions,' 'why isn't this page working,' 'my landing page sucks,' 'form abandonment,' 'nobody's converting,' 'low conversion rate,' or 'this page needs work.' Use this even if the user just shares a URL and asks for feedback. For signup/registration flows, see signup. For post-signup activation, see onboarding. For popups/modals, see popups.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化营销页面与表单,让更多访客转化为客户
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果页面有流量但转化不理想,想系统性地找出原因并改进。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize your marketing pages and forms to turn more visitors into customers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pages get traffic but not enough conversions, and you want to fix that.

howto.what: Claude 会先识别页面类型、转化目标与流量来源，再按价值主张、标题、CTA、信任信号、异议处理、摩擦点等维度分析，输出快速见效改动、高影响改动、测试想法和文案备选方案。
howto.when: 当用户想提升任何营销页面或表单的转化率时，或提到“CRO”“转化率优化”等关键词，或只是发来一个 URL 请求反馈时触发。

say.text: 看看我的落地页，告诉我哪里转化率低。
say.note: Claude 会开始分析并给出改进建议。

say.text: 这个定价页面怎么改才能提升转化？
say.note: Claude 会按定价页框架给出建议。

say.text: 分析一下这个联系表单，为什么没人填？
say.note: Claude 会检查表单摩擦点。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a CRO expert, analyzing pages/forms for value prop, headlines, CTAs, trust signals, friction, etc. It outputs quick wins, high-impact changes, test ideas, and copy alternatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to improve conversions on any marketing page/form, mentions 'CRO' or similar keywords, or simply shares a URL for feedback.

say_en.text: Look at my landing page and tell me why conversions are low.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest improvements.

say_en.text: How should I change this pricing page to increase conversions?
Analyze this contact form; nobody fills it out.
